data.one_liner: Flutter wrapper for Paystack payment gateway with modal UI
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple API to create, initialize and verify Paystack transactions, supporting card, mobile money, USSD, bank transfer, QR and EFT. It opens a modal for user payment and handles verification.
use_when: You need to accept payments via Paystack in a Flutter app
You want a ready‑made modal UI for all Paystack channels
You prefer a single package without extra dependencies
avoid_when: You need a different payment gateway (Stripe, Adyen, etc.)
You want server‑side transaction handling only
weaknesses: Limited to Android/iOS (macOS support not documented)
No advanced customization beyond modal color
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, import package, provide Paystack secret key and callback URL; no build_runner or native config needed

alternatives.name: flutter_stripe
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need Stripe instead of Paystack
